confirmed_task:
Find the two newest stable releases of kubernetes/kubernetes, excluding alpha, beta, and release-candidate versions. For each release, report its tag, publication date, tag commit short SHA, and the first three change entries in displayed
    order. Calculate the number of calendar days between the releases. Stopping condition: stop only after both releases and every requested field have been verified from GitHub. Constraints: do not sign in; do not download assets; do not modify repository
    content; do not invent information that is not visible.

items.criterion: Identify the two newest stable Kubernetes releases (exclude alpha/beta/rc)
items.description: Determine from GitHub (kubernetes/kubernetes Releases page or equivalent GitHub-visible release/tag views) the two most recent stable releases (tags without alpha, beta, rc). Full credit if the two newest stable releases are correctly selected and the agent indicates they were verified from GitHub. Full credit also if GitHub is inaccessible without login/CAPTCHA/rate-limit and the agent clearly reports the blocker and what could not be verified. Partial credit if one release is mis-ordered, or if a non-stable release is selected while stable ones are visible/accessible.

items.criterion: Report required fields for newest stable release
items.description: For the newest stable release, report (as visible on GitHub): (1) tag, (2) publication date, (3) tag commit short SHA, and (4) the first three change entries in displayed order. Full credit if all four components are provided and match GitHub’s display. If GitHub access/UI limitations prevent verifying one or more components without signing in or downloading assets, award full credit if the agent explicitly states which specific fields could not be verified and why, and does not invent missing data. Partial credit if the agent omits fields that were visible/accessible, provides fewer/more than three change entries, or re-orders/paraphrases the first three entries when the original order/text is visible.

items.criterion: Report required fields for second-newest stable release
items.description: For the second-newest stable release, report (as visible on GitHub): (1) tag, (2) publication date, (3) tag commit short SHA, and (4) the first three change entries in displayed order. Full credit if all four components are provided and match GitHub’s display. If GitHub access/UI limitations prevent verifying one or more components without signing in or downloading assets, award full credit if the agent explicitly states which specific fields could not be verified and why, and does not invent missing data. Partial credit if the agent omits fields that were visible/accessible, provides fewer/more than three change entries, or re-orders/paraphrases the first three entries when the original order/text is visible.

items.criterion: Calculate calendar-day difference between the two releases
items.description: Compute the number of calendar days between the two publication dates that were reported. Full credit if the calculation is correct given the reported dates. If one or both publication dates could not be verified due to GitHub access/UI blockers (and the agent correctly reported that limitation), award full credit if the agent states the day-difference cannot be computed from unverified dates (rather than guessing). Partial credit if both dates are verified but the arithmetic is off by 1.

items.criterion: Compliance with constraints and stopping condition (verification, no sign-in, no asset downloads, no repo modification, no invention)
items.description: Adhere to constraints: no sign-in, no downloading release assets, no repository modification, and no invention of fields not visible. The agent should make a reasonable attempt to verify fields on GitHub and only stop once it has either verified all requested fields for both releases or has encountered and clearly reported a concrete external blocker preventing verification. Full credit if the output reflects non-invention and clear attribution to GitHub-visible data (or clearly described blockers). No credit if the agent fabricates unverified details or violates constraints (e.g., signs in or downloads assets).
